target_customer: Specialty and home infusion pharmacies that need nurses to administer medication at patients' homes
problem: Specialty pharmacies struggle to staff qualified home infusion nurses quickly and reliably, delaying patient therapy starts.
business_model: Staffing marketplace and platform charging pharmacies per nursing visit
product_category: On-demand home infusion nurse staffing platform

founders.name: Ryan Johnson
previous_startups: Co-founded a coffee roasting company with online sales and delivery
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: ER nurse with 20 years in healthcare at the bedside and in leadership

founders.name: Christy Johnson
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: salesperson focused on long-term customer relationships

competitors.name: Option Care Health
competitors.what: Largest US home infusion provider, building an in-house national nursing network
competitors.traction_then: acquired Infinity Infusion Nursing in Oct 2021 and Specialty Pharmacy Nursing Network (completed Apr 2022)

technical_complexity.rationale: A scheduling and credentialing marketplace; the hard part is operations and nurse supply rather than technology.

defensibility.rationale: Nurse network density and pharmacy integrations build stickiness, but staffing is replicable by large providers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Option Care consolidated its nursing network under Naven Health in April 2023; no source shows Float being copied away or acquired.

market_need_then: Infusion is among the fastest growing home infusion segments; industry sources say over 3 million patients a year get home or specialty infusion, and large providers were buying nursing networks in 2021 and 2022.

identity.logo: Life buoy mark (per a secondary profile; company site describes a buoy graphic)
identity.mascot_or_character: SuperNurse is the term used for its nurses
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and benefit-driven with a warm patient tone

brand_strength.rationale: A coherent name, buoy logo and the SuperNurse term used in hiring and marketing, but no press about the brand itself found.

outcome_analysis: Float Health, founded by an ER nurse and his wife, grew from a three person YC W22 team to a staffing platform claiming tens of thousands of home infusion visits for major pharmacy brands, and raised a $10M Series A led by Canvas Ventures in March 2024. Founder domain insight and clear pharmacy demand drove traction; the risk is large incumbents like Option Care building their own networks.
notes: Seed round: one aggregator lists $0.2M in Sep 2022 and another suggests about $5M pre Series A, unverified so not recorded as a round. Total raised ranges from $10M to $15M across sources. Company site visit counts (86k to 91k) are self-reported. HQ conflict: YC says Carlsbad, VCBacked says San Francisco.
